subject: Proportions for TV units and feature walls
hook: How big should my media wall be for my TV?
fb:
A question we get at almost every consultation: "How big should the media wall be for my TV?"

Honest answer: the room sets the size, the TV just has to sit comfortably in it. We place the screen near your seated eye height, give it a margin so it doesn't look squeezed, and plan for the next TV too, since most people upgrade the screen long before the furniture.

Got a question about your own wall? Ask it below or book a free design consultation.

gbp:
"How big should my media wall be for my TV?"

It's one of the most common questions we're asked, and the answer starts with the room rather than the screen. A media wall should suit the width and height of the wall it sits on, with the TV placed so its centre is close to your seated eye height.

We then leave a clear margin around the screen so it doesn't look squeezed, and we plan for a larger TV in future, because screens tend to be replaced long before fitted furniture is.

At a free, no-obligation design consultation we measure your wall, chimney breast and alcoves, check where you sit, and show you a layout before anything is made. Every media wall is made in our Hanley workshop and fitted by our own team.

Book a consultation to get the right size for your room.
